title: NODE — The River Flats, South of a Broken Bridge

features.name: the river, carrying two
features.desc-on-touch: Depending on the current they would lie on their backs and let it carry them, then doggy paddle to the starting point. Again and again. Sometimes holding hands like synchronised swimmers, sometimes in counterpoint.

features.name: the soap caddy
features.desc-on-touch: Prised open on the way down the embankment. When the soap slipped away down river, both parties held a salute and thanked it for its service.

features.name: a broken bridge, possibly worsened
features.desc-on-touch: It may have got worse when they tried to take the truck over.

features.name: clothes on reeds and saplings
features.desc-on-touch: A ballet routine performed a half dozen times a week.

inscription: whatever one of us was saying at the time would be replaced by splashing water

file.name: Soap_Service_Record.txt
file.note: Served a half dozen times a week. Last seen heading down river. Saluted.

reverie.title: REVERIE — the flats beside a river
narr: Clothes hung on reeds and saplings. You braced for the chill.
You washed her long hair and hummed new odes into the genesis myth,
the only man and woman on this empty planet.
When the soap slipped away down river you both held a salute.
Then the first mosquito took blood, and you took your revenge,
and whatever was being said was replaced by splashing water.
